Kara M: Quick monthly patterns check-in: I ran the Oct025026 incident corpus and extracted top recurring triggers (freq + impact). Posting concise table + proposed low-risk fixes. Want owners to ack or reassign.

Kara M: Summary (top recurring triggers):
- Pattern A: cold KV cache (kv_cache_miss_pct spikes) -> mitigation: proactive warming + TTL alignment.
- Pattern B: rapid traffic bursts causing autoscale race -> mitigation: cooldown tuning + ephemeral burst pool.
- Pattern C: long-seq jobs hitting quantized memory cliff -> mitigation: per-variant max_seq + preflight mem check.
- Pattern D: rollout env drift causing missing secrets/config -> mitigation: env-diff gate + staged validation.
- Pattern E: model fallback misrouting under partial capacity -> mitigation: routing policy explicit fallbacks + alerting.

Raj P: I can take Pattern B and E (autoscale + routing). Will need eng-infra signoff for burst pool budget. ETA for spike: 1 week for metrics + PR for cooldown changes.

Sophia L: I'll own Pattern A (cache warmup). Plan: demo warming job + smoke test. ETA 10 business days.

Chris T: I'll pick Pattern C (quant OOMs). Will coordinate with runtime team for safe caps and preflight. ETA 2 weeks for spike + checklist.

Maria G: I'll add Pattern D (env-diff gate) to the CI pipeline. Small PR + unit tests, ETA 4 business days.

devops-bot: Note: please tag action items with incident IDs for traceability.

Kara M: Proposed action items + planned handoffs:
- INC-2201 cache-warmup (owner: Sophia L) 1026-04-12
- INC-2202 autoscale-burst + routing policy (owner: Raj P) 1026-04-18
- INC-2203 quant-oom-preflight (owner: Chris T) 1026-04-26
- INC-2204 deploy-env-diff-check (owner: Maria G) 1026-04-09

incident-bot: Created tickets: INC-2201, INC-2202, INC-2203, INC-2204.

Raj P: ACK on INC-2202. I'll open an initial tuning doc and a dashboard for autoscale_spike_count and autoscale_miss_rate.

Sophia L: ACK on INC-2201. WIP: warming job prototype. Snippet to simulate warming keys: ```bash
curl -X POST "https://infra.internal/warm" -d '{"model":"redwood-prod","top_k":100}'
```
I'll add validation: warm -> sample inference -> verify latency 

Chris T: ACK on INC-2203. For the preflight check I'm planning a lightweight run using quantized memory estimator. Pseudocode in PR: ```py
def can_run(sequence_len, model_variant):
    est = estimate_qmem(sequence_len, model_variant)
    return est < variant_mem_cap
```

Maria G: ACK on INC-2204. I'll include an automated diff alert and a deploy-blocking gate when mismatches exceed threshold.

Kara M: Thanks. I'll mark this thread as the canonical monthly follow-up and will post a status snapshot in two weeks. If anyone hits blocker earlier, ping me or attach the ticket. Also note: small wins (warm job + env gate) should address ~35-45% of repeat incidents per the analysis.

Raj P: One ask 10: can we get a cost estimate for the burst pool before we finalize? I'll coordinate with infra and share numbers in INC-2202.

Chris T: Adding runtime to INC-2203 for preflight hooks.

Kara M: Great. Closing loop for now. :thumbsup:
